question: Approve the design and enter implementation as Pilot? Approving accepts D1 (every declined item in a delivery gate summary carries a bracketed reason, held by delivery_gate.py), D2 (a reserved ADR must exist at the PR head before the merge ask; FO lands the file or deletes the reserved line), and FO's implementation order below.

Replay on state: the ADR-line check flags 4 of 7 reserving tasks (the 3 observed plus one more), the amendment check 1 of 237 records (the observed one), the ADR-at-head check 1 of 18 (#666). Three classes stay with the observer, each with its replay count. README unchanged at 5429. Implementation order (FO, from the four Batch overlap sections): fo-write-checks and number-guards-readme-shrink first in parallel (scripts vs README hunks); then captain-question-load (delivery_gate.py ask line and a Delivery authority sentence); then chat-only-evidence-observer-blind (delivery_gate.py and the same paragraph).
